list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Discrete [Cp*3Y3(μ-Cl)3(μ3-Cl)(μ3-CH2)(THF)3] cluster. Three Y centers and three bridging chlorides alternate around the equator of a distorted hexagonal-bipyramidal core; a μ3-chloride and a μ3-methylidene occupy the apical positions. Each Y also binds a Cp* ligand and a THF molecule. The article reports a monoclinic P21/n crystal structure.

synthesis.procedure: Treat the toluene-sparingly-soluble yttrium methyl–aluminate chloride precursor 2 with THF to form a clear solution; colorless crystals of 4a form at ambient temperature after 3 days. The main text gives no numerical reagent amount.

reagents.amount: 450 μL of a 1 M solution (0.9 equiv)
reagents.name: Dimethylaluminum chloride

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless crystals obtained from the clear solution.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Discrete [Cp*3La3(μ-Cl)3(μ3-Cl)(μ3-CH2)(THF)3] cluster, isostructural with yttrium analogue 4a. Three La centers and three bridging chlorides alternate around the equator of a distorted hexagonal-bipyramidal core; a μ3-chloride and a μ3-methylidene occupy the apical positions. Each La also binds a Cp* ligand and a THF molecule. The article reports a monoclinic P21/n crystal structure.

synthesis.procedure: Allow the toluene-insoluble hexanuclear lanthanum methyl–aluminate chloride precursor 3 to dissolve slowly in a toluene/THF mixture (2/3); harvest colorless crystals of 4b after 2 days at ambient temperature. The solvent ratio is reported, but no numerical reagent amount is given in the main text.

reagents.amount: 580 μL of a 1 M solution (1.3 equiv)
reagents.name: Dimethylaluminum chloride

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals harvested from the clear, colorless toluene/THF solution.
